unit: % of frame height (leader line length beyond the dot's 6 px radius)
sampling: captured pictures only (24/30 fps cadence on the 60 fps grid)
note: S07 callout 6 of 7 (bottom left), leader line: thin light vertical line drawn from the anchor dot down toward the pill's slot. Length = rows from the dot centre to the last row whose horizontal top-hat residual (1 x 11 px opening, max over a 5 px band at the dot's x) is >= 14 luma, minus the dot's 6 px radius (scratch/v8c3r_S07_c6_dotline_2076-2124.csv). None to f2090; 14 px (f2092), 35, 52, 63, 71 (f2101), 75, 80 (f2104), 82 px (f2106); to-value 81 px (8.82% H) = mean of f2104-f2106. Range ends at f2106 because from then on the far end lies in the light rim of the rising pill (rim luma 215-222 against the line's 225-232, column profile at f2112), so the read end retreats with the pill (77-79 px at f2108-f2118, 75 px at f2124) while the line itself does not visibly shorten. The pill grows from its f2094 speck while the line draws.
